method.unit: L1 survey-wave domain-mean cell matched to same-year public DHS-API indicator
method.models: inverse-variance WLS: pooled y~x; within-between y ~ (x-country_mean) + country_mean
method.holdouts: leave-one-country-out and last-wave holdout; baseline = training weighted mean
method.effective_n: number of countries (4) for cross-country statements; cells are not independent

guardrails.ecological_fallacy: country-level indicator is not a household measurement
